articles.title: Brilliant Moves: Coffee with The Coca-Cola Company CEO Henrique Braun
articles.summary: The Coca-Cola Company’s Henrique Braun and McKinsey’s Vik Malhotra discuss how an enduring institution keeps moving forward, and why staying constructively discontented may be the secret to staying relevant.

articles.title: Reinventing business planning with agentic AI
articles.summary: Combining better forecasting with AI agents will turn planning into a more continuous, intelligent, and responsive decision-making system—and reduce the manual work required to turn forecasts into action.

articles.title: System advantage: The new source of value in chemicals
articles.summary: As the favorable conditions that long supported the chemicals industry fade, advantage is being redefined around where companies compete and how they operate, innovate, and deploy their cash.

articles.title: The new realities of grocery retail in the Americas and Europe
articles.summary: From AI and private brands to premium products and wellness-focused shopping, grocery retailers face new opportunities—and hard choices.

articles.title: Global Banking Annual Review 2026: The AI disruption dividend
articles.summary: Banking outdid itself—again—earning a record $1.3 trillion in profits in 2025. Now the AI disruption dividend is up for grabs, and it will go to the banks that move with precision and speed. This time, there is no grace period.
